_: Ground contact is measured: per-asset designedSinkM comes from the makers' own placements (world/sources/placement/kit-designed-sink.json) or, failing that, from the mesh tell. What survives here is the anchor mode and the buryCapM ceiling per class, plus the policy-fallback sink for assets with neither kind of evidence: 0 in every policy, contact (planner ruling 4, 2026-09-26, decision 0102: a burial with no evidence buried the Claywater props 0.08 to 0.39 m); a measured sink always wins over it. assetPolicyEvidence: why an asset row overrides its kit's policy where the mined contact vote is ambiguous (16h round 12). deckClearanceM (stilt policy): the deck top's height above the support surface where the plugins give no evidence (16h round 13). fallbackWaterlineM (16h round 18): the pivot's depth under the water surface a water-class asset takes when no plugin gives it a waterline (evidence policy in the mounts record); only rows that seat water-class assets carry it (water-zero watercraft 0.0, stilt plank ferry 0.12, pad rubble 0.18, dug-in wrecks 0.35), never read from fallbackSinkM. assetPlacement (planner ruling 2026-09-24): a reviewed per-asset row that decides the asset's anchorClass, designedSinkM and/or designedWaterlineM (metres, pivot-relative as in the manifests) ahead of the mined records when the manifests are refreshed (placement_metadata.py --refresh-built-manifests [--kit ID]); evidence policy; every row carries its why and a field it leaves out keeps the mined value. kitAssetPolicies (planner ruling W2, 16k fix 2 round 4): a per-asset row scoped to one kit, deciding first for that kit; an interior-zero kit otherwise outranks an unscoped assetPolicies row (authored for the asset's exterior use). The rows here are the assets that live only in interior-zero kits, whose unscoped row can only have meant that kit; they stay in assetPolicies too because mine_mounts and mesh_ground_line read that section.

plinth.evidence: Reviewed plinth policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

pad.evidence: Reviewed graded-pad policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

stilt.evidence: Reviewed stilt/deck policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract. A stilt or quay piece is seated by its DECK, never its leg tips (owner 2026-09-23): with no plugin evidence its mesh tell is the deck top, set deckClearanceM above the support surface, and the legs bury as deep as they need (pipeline/mesh_ground_line.py).

dug-in.evidence: Reviewed dug-in ruin policy matching authored blueprint groundFit and the Phase 11 settlement grounding contract.

route-structure.evidence: Reviewed route deck/landing policy matching the compiled route-structure grounding contract.

interior-zero.evidence: Reviewed interior-piece fallback: authored interior transforms supply the floor datum, so terrain burial is forbidden.

water-zero.evidence: Reviewed watercraft fallback: water placement supplies the surface datum, so terrain burial is forbidden.

deck.evidence: Reviewed rests-on-a-host policy (16h round 13): a piece built to rest on another piece (the Telvanni treehouse connector on its tree or platform) takes the deck anchor class where its mined contact vote is ambiguous; the host supplies the datum, so terrain burial is forbidden, as for interior-zero.

vanilla:architecture/tents/largeimperial.why: Legion command tent: canvas on poles with no floor slab, open at the front; 0105 R58 judges it at its poles and its canvas skirt (16k walk 9, The Broke Column). anchorClass ground is the mounts miner's plugin class.

vanilla:architecture/tents/smallimperial.why: Legion tent: canvas on poles with no floor slab, open at both gable ends; 0105 R58 judges it at its poles and its canvas skirt (16k walk 9, The Broke Column). Its long-side canvas edges end 0.43 m (front) and 0.50 m (back) over the mesh's lowest point, so on the plugin sink (p50 0.11 m) they hovered 0.41 m over a levelled pad (check, walk 9); the sink is lowered to 0.48 m so every canvas edge meets the ground and the gable poles go 0.5 m in. anchorClass ground is the mounts miner's plugin class (85 of 88 refs on ground).

vanilla:landscape/rocks/rockcaveentrance.why: Skyrim's cave-mouth rock (30.7 x 32.2 x 19.5 m): its tunnel floor rises from 1.58 m under the pivot at the load door to the mouth's lip 7.8 m out along the tunnel axis (106 deg in its frame), 3.79 m above the mesh's lowest point, and an apron then falls 3.5 m away outside the lip into the hillside (vertical rays through the raw GLB, 16k walk 9, tooling/.reports/16k/walk9/place-type-5.md). The plugins set it into slopes (24 refs, mined sink p50 -2.38 m on their hillside land); on level ground the way in is flush only when the lip meets the lowest ground under the rock (the dug-in line), so the pivot, 0.02 m under the lip, stands 0.02 m above that line: designed sink -0.02 m (lesson L25). Seated at the mined row the lip stood 2.2 m above the approach at Takes-The-Tools.

bmv:advertising_board.why: BM&V roofed notice board (1.56 x 1.39 x 2.47 m): a stone pedestal about 0.8 m tall carrying the papered board and its little roof; the pedestal's foot, the lowest mesh, lies 0.041 m under the pivot and stands on the ground. No plugin reference is mined (n 0); the mesh-sill tell read a 'foundation-top' at +1.82 m, the board's lower edge, and sank the pedestal and the board into the ground so only the roof showed (walk-9 Claywater close-up, tooling/placement-workbench/output/renders/dtp-cw/round-1/01-front-d9-notice.png, while `burialRule` allowed it as designed).

htbm:here there be monsters - curse of c.why: Here There Be Monsters' Argonian awning: a hide canopy on three bent log posts (5.34 x 4.94 x 5.83 m at unit scale). Its look sheet (tooling/.reports/look/settlement-stilt-v1__e_there_be_monsters_curse_of_cipactli_architecture_villages_argonian_orcawning01.png) shows the posts running 0.91 m under the pivot plane: post ends made to be sunk, so the pivot stands on the ground (sink 0) and the posts go 0.91 m x scale into it. The mod places it 3 times, all at scale 0.65 in its Hesperide village (kit-setting-class: exterior wild), so the sink miner drops every reference as non-unit scale (n 0, mesh-sill fallback). Place it at scale 0.65, as the mod does.

Here There Be Monsters' washing line (2.51 x 1.27 x 2.28 m): two forked log posts with a rope slung between them (look sheet, walk 9). The posts' feet are the mesh's lowest points, at the pivot (originOffsetM z 0.0), and stand on the ground. No plugin places it (n 0), so the row is reviewed here: the posts stand on the ground, sink 0.

kotm:argonia/clutter/beehive.why: King of the Murkmire's two hives on a bench (3.08 x 1.73 x 3.11 m): the bench's four feet are the lowest mesh, 0.074 m under the pivot, and they stand on the ground; nothing is meant to bury. The per-asset sink run (walk 9, `mine_designed_sink --assets ... --merge`) found no plugin reference on land (n 0) and fell back to this same mesh-sill value; the walk-9 close-up (tooling/placement-workbench/output/renders/dtp-look/round-1/01-front-lk373.png) shows the feet on the red ground line.

vanilla:architecture/riften/rtmarketstal.why: Riften market stall (2.05 x 2.23 x 3.07 m): its counter frame and posts end at the pivot plane, the lowest mesh, and stand on the ground with nothing buried. The per-asset sink run (walk 9) found its three Skyrim.esm references all standing over Riften's canal water (refsNoLand 3, n 0 on land) and fell back to this same mesh-sill value. The walk-9 close-up (tooling/placement-workbench/output/renders/dtp-look/round-1/05-front-lk409.png) shows the frame on the ground line.

htbm:here there be monsters - curse of c.why: Here There Be Monsters' half pavilion (8.17 x 5.02 x 5.83 m): a thatched canopy on log posts whose feet, the lowest mesh, lie 0.911 m under the pivot, the same pivot the same mod's bamboohut01 and bamboohut02 carry on the same log stakes. The plugin places the pavilion on no land the sink miner can read (n 0, mesh-sill fallback at -0.911, posts standing on the ground); its two siblings are measured on their own plugin ground (bamboohut02 p50 -0.111, n 9; bamboohut01 p50 -0.093, n 7), so the mod stands that pivot about 0.1 m over the ground and drives the stakes 0.8 m in. This row takes the siblings' -0.10 (Tag House, 16k walk 9, place-type-6 lane; close-up tooling/.reports/16k/place.imperial-penal-south.rose-bone-waystation/look/).

bmv:architecture/citebosmer/passerelles/.why: Bosmer walkway stair: its bottom tread band lies at the pivot (z 0 to 0.1 m) and its supports reach 1.54 m below. The stair's foot stands on the ground and the supports are buried, so the pivot sits at the ground (sink 0). The mesh-sill tell took the supports' feet (-1.54 m) and stood the bottom tread 1.54 m in the air.

bmv:architecture/philscaves/small/doorca.why: Cave mouth: its walkable floor at the opening (the up-facing band from y 0 to 0.5 m, |x| under 1 m) lies at z -1.36 m, 0.467 m above the mesh bottom (-1.827 m) the door-sill tell took. A dug-in piece's threshold is flush with the approach, so the sill is the ground line and the rock skirt below it buries (owner check-in 2, finding 9).

bmv:architecture/stilthouse/stilthousedo.why: Door leaf 2.35 x 0.09 m with its bottom at the pivot: it hangs on its frame in the stilt house doorway. No plugin places it alone, so the record reads ground/unplaced.

bmv:architecture/stilthouse/stilthouseex.why: The stilt house deck stands 3.462 m (asset metres) above its support surface: the median of BM&V's four placements (3.29 to 3.86 m per placement in asset metres, over lake water on 5 to 7 of 9 samples under the legs; check-in 2 fix, /tmp/wf/checkin2fix/yard/clearance_all.json). A stilt piece is seated by its deck above the water where water covers the legs, else above the ground, so its class is ground, never water; the legs bury as deep as they need.

composite:docks/quay-run-2.why: Two vanilla dock decks (dockstrent01 and dockstrent02) on pilings reaching 6.3 m under the deck top. The vanilla and BM&V placements of those two pieces hold their decks a median 0.672 m above the water or ground under them (258 references; dockstrent01 0.547 m, n 83; dockstrent02 0.711 m, n 175), so the deck stands 0.672 m above the water and the pilings bury. No plugin places the composite itself.

composite:stilt/stilthouse-with-door.why: The stilt house with its door leaf: the shell's deck and the shell's plugin deck height (stilthouseext row, 3.462 m median over four BM&V placements).

htbm:here there be monsters - curse of c.why: HTBM places this Kothringi dock 35 times, always at scale 2.0, with its deck 2.28 m above the ground or water under it (median; 1.14 m in asset metres, p25 1.14, p75 1.165). The 0.35 m default buried all but the rail.

mudmother:gv_meshes/argoniannest/argonia.why: A cage lantern with a hanging ring on top; no plugin places it (mounts record n 0). Stood on the ground at Claywater, its chain rendered as a rigid rod. The night reader saw it as floating (16k fix 2 layout r3). It is hung from a mined parent, never settled.

kotm:argonia/mudhuts/smpodext02.why: King of the Murkmire places this pod 7 times, 6 of them turned over (x rotation 164.6 to 198.3 deg) with its porch smpodextdoor beside it; the one upright reference stands 4.81 m up. A lived-in place builds it as the plugin does, composite:mud/kotm-house-pod; the upright mesh stays for ruins (16k fix 2, interiors r8 (a)).

vanilla:architecture/docks/dockstrent01.why: Dock deck at the pivot on 6.23 m pilings: it stands in the water. Vanilla chains these decks on each other (67 of 83 references on another deck), so the contact vote reads deck; the waterline stays the plugin value (67 references).

vanilla:clutter/signage/whiterun/signwrp.why: Sign post 2.74 m tall with its base at the pivot and the arm at the top: it stands on the ground. The plugin vote splits deck 4 / ground 3 / wall 1 because Whiterun sets several posts on stone paving; the plugin sink (n 5) stays.

vanilla:architecture/riften/rtstables01.why: Riften stable: the stall floor (a 49.3 m2 up-facing band at z 0.004 m) lies at the pivot and the stone foundation reaches 0.91 m below it. The stalls are walked into from the ground, so the pivot sits at the ground (sink 0) and the foundation is buried. The mesh-sill tell took the foundation's foot (-0.91 m, n 0: RiftenWorld has no LAND) and stood the stall floor 0.91 m in the air (0105 R25, planner 2026-09-28). The designed burial is therefore 0.91 m: (sink 0 + the pivot's 0.91 m over the mesh base) x scale, which burialRule allows for this reviewed row (seat_rules DESIGNED_ROW_EVIDENCE, planner ruling 1 CLAYWATER2 2026-09-28). Evidence: the mesh's floor-to-base offset (a 56.5 m2 up-facing band at z 0.0 over a foot at -0.9103 m; kit-designed-sink groundLineTell floor-plane -0.9103) and the plugin's placement (Riften places it as a walked-into stall, its ray-confirmed open front at sill 0.0, clear 2.04 m, interiors_index walk 4 lane PARTS; the sink miner reads n 0 because RiftenWorld has no LAND).

histtree:skyfall/sleeping tree overhaul/.why: Hist tree, 24.9 x 27.1 x 24.4 m. The one Skyfall reference is rooted in 1.33 m of cell water (0105 R19), and its sink (-0.6723, n 1) stands the root flare 0.30 m (base-band p50 on a 0.25 m ray grid) over the ground at Greenspring, held up by one root spike 0.745 m down. Evidence 'owner walk 4' (planner 2026-09-28, lane GREENSPRING2): the mesh-flare row (p50 -0.12) plus a further 0.15 m for the owner's 'slightly lower', stated by the planner as 0.27 m under the plugin sink; applied as that stated height, -0.6723 + 0.27 = -0.4023 (tooling/.reports/16k/walk4/deliver-GREENSPRING2.md).
The sick texture variant of the ancient sleeping tree: the same mesh, so the same sink (kit-build texture variants). Evidence 'owner walk 4', as the healthy tree's row.

Rune circle, an 8.1 x 9.0 m stone disc. Skyfall places it once, scaled, on the Hist's mound; the miner drops that reference (byScaleRefsDropped 1), so no plugin sink exists. The mesh's floor plane lies 0.606 m below the pivot and is the disc's underside: sink -0.606 sets that underside on the ground, the disc's rim standing its full height above it. (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

Hist flower, 3.5 m. The mesh sits 5.854 m above its pivot (Skyfall authors it in the tree's frame); its lowest point is the foot of its root bulb. Skyfall places all 3 references scaled on the tree's roots, never on LAND (byScaleRefsDropped 3). Sink 5.854 m sets that foot on the ground (the mesh-sill tell's 6.196 m buried the bulb 0.34 m, which propSeatRule refuses for a prop). (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

Hist flower, 4.3 m. The mesh sits 6.009 m above its pivot (authored in the tree's frame); the stem's foot is its lowest point. Skyfall places all 7 references scaled on the tree's roots, never on LAND (byScaleRefsDropped 7). Sink 6.009 m sets the stem's foot on the ground. (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

The sick texture variant of histflower02: the same mesh, so the same sink (6.009 m, the stem's foot on the ground; kit-build § texture variants). (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

vanilla:architecture/docks/dockstr4way01.why: Four-way dock junction, 7.3 m tall with piles. All four plugin references stand it in water (Skyrim.esm and Black Marsh.esm; anchor vote water 4 of 4, waterline p50 -0.03 m), so no ground sink exists to measure. It seats as a piled deck by its deck rise, never by this sink; its deck top lies at the pivot: sink -0.35 keeps the deck 0.35 m over the bank (the deck-top tell's clearance) if it ever meets the shore. Riverwalk lw06: the deck is level with the run and the piles stand in water (wb.py render iso --focus lw06 wb02, 2026-10-01). (0105 R36, reviewed 2026-10-01; per-asset sink miner sample measured no LAND reference)

vanilla:architecture/docks/dockstepsdown.why: Dock steps down to the water, 9.0 m tall with piles. Its makers hang it off a deck end (it abuts dockstrsol01) and its four land references disagree by 9.25 m IQR (pluginSpread), so no ground sink is measured. It seats by its designed abut to the deck above, never by this sink; its top step lies at the pivot: sink -0.35 is the deck-top tell's clearance. Riverwalk wb02: snapped to wb01 by evidence, the lowest step in 0.58 m of water (wb.py render iso --focus lw06 wb02, 2026-10-01). (0105 R36, reviewed 2026-10-01; per-asset sink miner sample measured no agreeing LAND set)

vanilla:architecture/docks/dockstrent02.why: Dock entrance piece, 7.2 m tall with piles. Its makers stand it in water (waterline row n 3, p50 -1.59 m); on land the four plugins disagree by 3.07 m IQR (pluginSpread), so no ground sink is measured. Its deck top lies at the pivot and the piles reach down from it: sink -0.35 keeps the deck 0.35 m over the bank (the deck-top tell's clearance) where it meets the shore. (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

bmv:sheogorad/dagon fel/cleat.why: Mooring cleat, 1.06 x 0.39 x 0.37 m. No mined plugin reference (n 0): Black Marsh sets it on dock decks, never on LAND. Its foot plane lies 0.184 m below the pivot: sink -0.184 rests the foot on the surface it is set on. (0105 R36, reviewed by lane L16 2026-09-28; sink miner run /tmp/l16/sink-sample.json and --merge --whole-population refused: no reference stands on LAND)

mudmother:gv_meshes/argoniannest/argonia.why: Mud Mother Grove hide shelter on poles, 6.1 x 5.3 m and 4.3 m tall. The plugin places it once, at a scale other than 1, so the sink miner drops it and no plugin sink exists. Its ground line is the canvas skirt, not the pole feet (16k walk 6: seated on the pole feet, 0.449 m below the pivot, every placed tent's front edge hovered 0.25-0.36 m). Measured on the mesh (wb.py bpy blender/examples/skirt_gap.py; kit frame per 15-degree sector, the outermost vertex within 0.6 m of the lowest): the skirt's highest outer edge stands 0.389 m over the pole feet; the ground line sits 0.03 m over that edge, so every canvas edge touches or enters the ground and the poles stand 0.42 m in it. floorClass openShelter: 0105 R58: a hide canopy on poles with no floor slab.

composite:stilt/swamp-house-with-landing.why: BM&V's swamp house, placed by the composite at scale 2.9. BM&V places the shell 47 times in 25 cells, all in open water, and its depth follows its scale: the pivot sits a median 0.22 m under the water at scale 2.6 (n 17), 1.36 m at 2.8 (n 10), 2.02 m at 2.9 (n 7) and 2.21 m at 3.0 (n 13); 1.45 m over all 47 (bmv-blackmarsh-placement.json, aboveWaterM). The row takes the scale-2.9 median, as the sink miner does for a scaled base (byScale): the floor stands 0.70 m over the water and the landing plank's deck 0.56 m. The sink miner has no row for it (it was in no kit). walkTopM 2.725: the floor, a 246 m2 up-facing band at z 2.443 m in the unit-2.6 shell (p50 over its triangles), is 2.725 m over the pivot at scale 2.9; sockets inside stand on it.

mudmother:gv_meshes/argoniannest/argonia.why: Mud Mother Grove hide shelter on poles, 8.2 x 7.0 m and 6.0 m tall; no plugin sink (placed once, off unit scale). Its ground line is the canvas skirt, not the pole feet (16k walk 6, same defect as argoniantent02). Measured on the mesh (wb.py bpy blender/examples/skirt_gap.py; kit frame per 15-degree sector, the outermost vertex within 0.6 m of the lowest): the skirt's highest outer edge stands 0.569 m over the pole feet, 0.4605 m below the pivot; the ground line sits 0.03 m over that edge. floorClass openShelter: 0105 R58: a hide canopy on poles with no floor slab.

kotm:argonia/blackwood/sign.why: Hanging shop sign: a re-textured vanilla Riften/Whiterun sign (rings and a hinge constraint in the NIF, no post of its own). King of the Murkmire's plugin places it nowhere, so the mounts vote is 'unplaced'; vanilla hangs every such sign from the bracket post signwrpost01 (kit-mounts-mined pairs signwrpost01 -> signwr*, 2.39 m up), which this kit carries.

piledDecks.why: Pier, dock, landing and walkway decks that stand on piles or legs (planner ruling, 16k walk 2 round 4). The workbench and runtime seat them by the DECK, which stands deckRiseM above the ground or water line, never by the foot of the piles. deckRiseM per asset: the assetPlacement row's deckClearanceM (mined from the plugin placements), else the deckClearanceM of the asset's deck-top mesh tell, else 0.3 m. Pilings, posts, cleats, planks, ramps and stairs that seat by their foot are not listed.

settingLicence._: Planner ruling, 16k walk 9 dressing follow-up: a piece its own plugin licenses nowhere outdoors (a modder's resource no plugin places, or vanilla dressing placed only indoors) is licensed outdoors PER SETTING CLASS by a reviewed row here, never blanket. place_gates setting.class (0105 R1/R9) reads it: the row licenses the piece in each named setting where ANY 'when' alternative holds, and an alternative holds when ALL its keys do: placeTypes (the record's classification.type), recordServices (any of the record's services), cultures (the record's culture), recordTerms (any term in the record's why, vibe, questHooks, sockets, contents or playerPurpose), parcelUses (the placement's parcel use bucket, blueprint.USE_BUCKET), parcelWaterEdge (a stilt-founded parcel or a dock, quay, pier or landing). Each placement is judged on its own parcel.

bmv:advertising_board.why: Black Marsh Vanilla's notice board, built as a modder's resource (its readme names a board for notices outside inns and markets; register row G3) and placed by no plugin. It is the only notice board in the pool, so a road station and any place with trade or a travel service may stand one outside.

htbm:here there be monsters - curse of c.why: Here There Be Monsters' Argonian washing line on two posts, in the mod's villages/argonian set but placed by none of its cells. A line of washing belongs in a household's yard, so it is licensed outdoors at a domestic parcel only.

mudmother:gv_meshes/argoniannest/sithiss.why: Mudmother's Sithis shrine stands only inside 00MudHut01. It is licensed outdoors where the record's culture is Argonian and the record names a Sithis or dead-cult provision (a Nisswo, a Sithis rite), never as generic village dressing.
